runtime_python_tool_audit.scope: Runtime Python scripts audited during source69 target graph validation. Engine compiled closure recorded separately. This does not attribute these tool versions to earlier rows.
runtime_python_tool_audit.benchmark_cli_difference: The later local script restricts layer-pipeline choices and rejects DFlash2 layer layout. All current trials use legacy layout, so these CLI differences are inactive.

runtime_host_memory_audit.scope: Read-only job memory-controller snapshot after the failed10240MiBquartet-cache experiment; counters are cumulative for the allocation.

limitations: Single timed128-output screens are not repeated512-output qualifications.
Early screens sample target-process faults/swap only; separately sampled worker residency is identified per row.
Synthetic real-weight draft probes omit target head, target verification and transport, and do not measure model tok/s.
Batched target arithmetic, CPUQ8 and bounded route dropping differ from the original BF16 target; no lossless claim.
Bounded acceptance and proposal calibration are independent opt-ins. Target weights and selected presets are unchanged.
Fresh twenty held-out coding checks remain unscored during tuning.
No resource capacity is fitted to a screen or kernel timing.

gpu_top16_output_parity.scope: Generated-output parity only. The GPU timing failed worker residency qualification and supplies no qualified speed comparison.
